lessons.title: What Is Bonfire Night?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say that Bonfire Night is a celebration with fireworks and bonfires in autumn.
lessons.starter_activity: Show a picture of fireworks and ask what children notice.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss simply what Bonfire Night is and how families celebrate (fireworks, sparklers, bonfires) safely.
key_questions: What happens on Bonfire Night?
Have you seen fireworks before?

differentiation.extension: Explain why we celebrate at night

lessons.assessment_notes: Note recall of cultural celebration facts — evidence for UTW.1/UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap key Bonfire Night facts.
lessons.home_link: Talk about Bonfire Night traditions in your family.

lessons.title: Firework Painting
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use paint/materials to represent a firework burst.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at photos of colourful fireworks.
lessons.main_activity: Children create firework pictures using splatter painting or oil pastel and paint wash techniques on black paper.
resources_needed: Black paper, bright paint, pastels, straws for splatter
key_questions: What colours are your fireworks?
How does it burst outward?

differentiation.extension: Create layered bursts with multiple colours

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe colour use and technique — evidence for EAD.1.
lessons.plenary: Display firework paintings together.
lessons.home_link: Look at firework colours together if watching a display safely.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'f'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'f' and blend words (fan, fun, fit).
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'f' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
key_questions: What sound is this?
Can you blend f-u-n?
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'f'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 17 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending fan, fun, fit.

lessons.title: Counting Down for a Firework Launch
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count backwards from 5 to 1.
lessons.main_activity: Children practise counting backwards from 5 to 0/1 with a 'rocket launch' action game.
key_questions: What comes after 3 when counting backwards?
Can you count down from 5?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note backward counting ability — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class countdown and 'launch' celebration.
lessons.home_link: Practise counting backwards from 5 together.

lessons.title: Fire Safety: What Can and Can't Be Touched
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain why fire and fireworks need adult supervision.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what happens if you touch something hot.
lessons.main_activity: Sort picture cards into 'safe to touch' and 'needs an adult/dangerous', discussing fire and firework safety.
key_questions: Why shouldn't children touch fireworks?
Who should be in charge of fire/fireworks?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note safety understanding — evidence for UTW.3/PSED.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap key fire safety rules.
lessons.home_link: Talk about fire safety rules at home.

lessons.title: Firework Sounds and Movement
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to move and make sounds representing different firework types.
lessons.main_activity: Children move and make matching sounds (whoosh, bang, crackle) representing different fireworks, building to a 'firework display' performance.
key_questions: What sound does a rocket make?
Can you move like a sparkling firework?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note expressive sound and movement — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Perform the class 'firework display' together.
lessons.home_link: Make firework sounds and movements with family.

lessons.title: Story Time: A Bonfire Night Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer a simple comprehension question about the story.
lessons.main_activity: Read a simple Bonfire Night themed story, pausing for comprehension questions.
key_questions: What happened in the story?
How did the character feel watching fireworks?

differentiation.extension: Answer in full sentences with reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite part of the story.
lessons.home_link: Share a bonfire/firework story or memory with family.

lessons.title: Firework Shape Hunt
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify circular and star shapes in firework images.
lessons.main_activity: Children spot and count circle/star shapes within firework pictures, sorting into groups.
resources_needed: Firework picture cards with varied shapes
key_questions: What shape is this firework burst?
How many stars can you find?

differentiation.extension: Identify multiple shapes and count occurrences

lessons.assessment_notes: Note shape recognition — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Class tally of shapes found.
lessons.home_link: Look for circle and star shapes at home.

lessons.title: The Story of Guy Fawkes (Simple Version)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall a very simple version of why we celebrate Bonfire Night.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss that Bonfire Night remembers something that happened long ago.
lessons.main_activity: Tell a very simple, age-appropriate version of the Guy Fawkes story, focusing on 'remembering' and 'long ago'.
key_questions: Did this happen a long time ago or recently?
Why do people still remember it?

differentiation.extension: Recall one detail from the story

lessons.assessment_notes: Note early understanding of past events/history — evidence for UTW.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap that Bonfire Night remembers a long-ago event.
lessons.home_link: Ask a family member what they know about Bonfire Night history.

lessons.title: Sparkler Wand Craft
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct a decorative sparkler-wand craft using materials.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a picture of a sparkler.
lessons.main_activity: Children make a pretend sparkler wand using a stick, ribbons, and shiny materials.
key_questions: How does your sparkler shine?
What materials did you use?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor and creative material use — evidence for EAD.1/PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Wave sparkler wands to music together.
lessons.home_link: Make a simple craft using ribbons or shiny paper at home.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'l'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'l' and blend words (leg, log, lip).
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'l' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
key_questions: What sound is this?
Can you blend l-e-g?
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'l'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 18 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending leg, log, lip.

lessons.title: Number Bonds to 5 Recap: Firework Bursts
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall number bonds to 5 using a firework-themed activity.
lessons.main_activity: Children draw firework bursts with two colours of 'sparks' (dots) that together make 5, recording combinations.
key_questions: How many of each colour did you use to make 5?
Can you find another way?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess number bond fluency — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Display all the different firework bond combinations.
lessons.home_link: Practise number bonds to 5 with any small objects at home.

lessons.title: Light in the Dark: Exploring Torches
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to observe how light works in a dark space.
lessons.starter_activity: Darken the room slightly and discuss how it feels.
lessons.main_activity: Children explore shining torches to make shadows/light patterns in a darkened area, discussing how light helps us see.
key_questions: What happens when you shine the torch here?
Why do we need light at night?

differentiation.extension: Make and describe shadow shapes with hands

lessons.assessment_notes: Note investigative observation of light — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap what was discovered about light and dark.
lessons.home_link: Explore torches or shadows together at home in the evening.

lessons.title: Bonfire Night Song and Dance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sing a Bonfire Night themed song with actions.
lessons.main_activity: Learn a simple Bonfire Night song with actions (whoosh, bang, sparkle), performing with increasing confidence.
key_questions: What action goes with this line?
Can you sing it a little louder?

differentiation.extension: Suggest and lead a new action

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and participation — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Perform the song once more for the group.
lessons.home_link: Sing the Bonfire Night song for family.

lessons.title: Writing Firework Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write simple firework-themed words.
lessons.main_activity: Children write/draw simple firework sound words (bang, pop) using known phonics sounds, adding to a firework picture.
key_questions: What word will you write?
What sound does it start with?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share firework word pictures with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Write a firework sound word together at home.

lessons.title: Patterns in Firework Displays
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to continue a repeating colour pattern in a firework design.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a simple ABAB colour pattern.
lessons.main_activity: Children continue and create their own repeating pattern using coloured dot stickers to represent a firework display.
key_questions: What comes next in this pattern?
Can you make your own pattern?

differentiation.support: Continue simple ABAB pattern with support
differentiation.extension: Create own more complex pattern (ABC, ABBA)

lessons.assessment_notes: Note pattern recognition and creation — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Display and admire patterned firework designs.
lessons.home_link: Look for and create patterns with objects at home.

lessons.title: Bonfire Night Recap: What We Learned
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about Bonfire Night learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Class discussion synthesising history, safety, and celebration facts into a 'Bonfire Night' display.
key_questions: What have we learned about Bonfire Night?
Why is it important to be safe?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.1/UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Unveil the finished display.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about Bonfire Night with your family.

lessons.title: Firework Display Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to combine song, movement, and craft props in a class performance.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all elements learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Whole-class 'firework display' performance combining the song, sparkler wands, and movement/sounds.
key_questions: What was your favourite part of this week?
How did it feel to perform?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and enjoyment — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Round of applause; recap the exciting week.
lessons.home_link: Perform the firework display for family this weekend.

lessons.title: Phonics Review: All 18 Sounds
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read CVC words and simple sentences using all sounds learned so far.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire flashcard review of all 18 sounds.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations: word-building, CVC reading cards, simple sentence reading.
key_questions: Can you build and read this word?
Can you read this sentence?
lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise week 10 phonics tracker.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all sounds learned with a reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading simple sentences over the weekend.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Counting Back, Shape, Pattern
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting backwards, shape recognition, and pattern skills from this week.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through 3 stations: counting backwards from 5, firework shape hunt recap, pattern continuation.
key_questions: Can you count backwards from 5?
What shape/pattern is this?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 10 maths observations.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising counting backwards over the weekend.
